tasks.gr10-plant-tissues-organs-t2: Grade 10 Life Sciences Term 2: Plant tissue types (meristematic, permanent) and organ systems in flowering plants.
tasks.gr10-animal-tissues-support-systems-t2: Grade 10 Life Sciences Term 2: Animal tissue types and support systems (skeletal and muscular systems).
tasks.gr10-transport-systems-mammals-t2: Grade 10 Life Sciences Term 2: Mammalian circulatory and lymphatic systems — heart, blood vessels and blood.
tasks.gr10-plants-root-stem-secondary-growth-t: Topic: Support and transport in plants 1: dicot root and stem (Grade 10 Life Sciences, Term 2). Cover where xylem, phloem, cortex, cambium and pith lie in a dicot root and stem, the cells of xylem, phloem, sclerenchyma and parenchyma, secondary growth by the cambium and annual rings (age of a tree, good and poor years, mean ring width). Give all data in the question.
tasks.gr10-plants-water-transpiration-t2: Topic: Support and transport in plants 2: water uptake and transpiration (Grade 10 Life Sciences, Term 2). Cover uptake of water by osmosis and minerals by active transport in root hairs, the path to the leaf, stomata, guard cells and cuticle, factors that affect transpiration (temperature, light intensity, wind, humidity) with potometer rates, wilting, guttation and translocation. Give all data in the question.
